answer: Jury of 9 drawn without replacement at the crystal: a farm holding k% of identities wins a full jury only k^9 of the time. The lotus check enforces this by verifying unique staked keys per draw. The pulse of honest graders dominates; at 10% sybil share, odds collapse to 10^-9, so farming costs 10^9× expected payout. Conclusion: k^9 sampling makes sybil capture economically irrational.
